findings.defect: The physical arrival of the System notification and holographic window is omitted.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly describes both the audible notification and the translucent window abruptly appearing before presenting the Quest.
findings.replacement:
Ding.

A System notification suddenly rang out. At the same time, a translucent holographic window shot up into the air.

> **System**
findings.source: 갑작스럽게 울리는 시스템 알림. 동시에 반투명한 홀로그램 창이 허공으로부터 불쑥 솟구쳤다.

findings.defect: The System choices retain square brackets, contrary to the required System-panel formatting.
findings.rationale: The System blockquote already frames these as UI choices, and the binding rules prohibit square brackets around System notices or UI terms.

findings.current: > - Various factors around you will change depending on your choice. Specific individuals may die in the process.
findings.defect: The singular warning about a certain person is changed into a plural warning about multiple individuals.
findings.rationale: 특정 인물이 is singular and points to one unspecified person; pluralizing it changes the Quest's stated potential consequence.
findings.replacement: > - Various factors around you will change depending on your choice. A certain person may die in the process.
findings.source: 그 과정에서 특정 인물이 사망할 수도 있습니다.

findings.defect: The profanity is intensified, erasing the source's distinction between this milder complaint and the later explicit 좆 된 것 같다는 line.
findings.rationale: 거지 같다 is a colloquial complaint meaning that something is lousy or shitty, whereas “fucked” more closely matches the stronger profanity used later.

findings.current: A few years later, my father suddenly died in a monster wave, and his Go account—marked by nothing but losses, yet maintained with unfailing consistency—became dormant.
findings.defect: “Nothing but losses” adds the unsupported claim that the account had no wins at all.
findings.rationale: 패배로 점철되긴 했어도 says the account was riddled with defeats, not that every game was a loss; the earlier statement that his win rate was terrible likewise does not establish a zero-win record.
findings.replacement: A few years later, my father died suddenly in a monster wave, and the Go account he had kept playing on despite its long record of defeats fell dormant.
findings.source: 아버지는 몇 해 뒤 몬스터 웨이브로 인해 갑작스럽게 돌아가셨고, 패배로 점철되긴 했어도 꾸준했던 아버지의 바둑 계정은 휴면 계정이 되었다.

findings.current: *Not that kind of move. It means a bad play. Like when Taekyung was playing soccer at the sports festival yesterday and accidentally kicked Minjun’s leg instead of the ball, causing us to lose the game. A bad choice. Do you understand?*
findings.defect: “Causing us to lose” incorrectly makes the father part of the side that lost and alters the subject of the source's causal explanation.
findings.rationale: The father describes Taekyung's bad choice causing Taekyung to lose the match; he does not say that “we” lost.
findings.replacement: *Not that kind of move. It means a bad play. It’s like when Taekyung played soccer at the sports festival yesterday and lost the game because he accidentally kicked Minjun’s leg instead of the ball. A bad choice. Do you understand?*
findings.source: 어제 태경이가 체육대회에서 축구 했을 때, 실수로 공이 아니라 민준이 다리를 걷어차는 바람에 경기에서 진 거랑 비슷한 거란다. 나쁜 선택. 이해되니?

findings.current: *But I got kicked out right away yesterday.*
findings.defect: “Kicked out” loses the soccer-specific meaning of being sent off.
findings.rationale: 퇴장당했다 refers to removal from the match, and “sent off” is the natural soccer terminology that preserves the joke's setup.
findings.replacement: *But I got sent off right away yesterday.*

findings.current: “I’m not sure whether it’s a tiger’s mouth or a dog’s mouth.”
findings.defect: The translation sanitizes 개새끼 and weakens Taekyung's insulting comparison.
findings.rationale: 개새끼 is strongly abusive here, not the neutral “dog”; the profanity is part of Taekyung's contemptuous humor.
findings.replacement: “I’m not sure whether it’s a tiger’s jaws or a fucking mutt’s.”

findings.current: “Is this because of me and the other members? Because you’re afraid we’ll be harmed if you avoid this place?”
findings.defect: “Avoid this place” is unnatural and fails to express the contemplated act of fleeing the confrontation.
findings.rationale: 이 자리를 피하면 refers to Taekyung escaping or abandoning the current situation, which is the active alternative posed by the Quest.
findings.replacement: “Is this because of me and the other members? Because you’re afraid we’ll be harmed if you flee from here?”
findings.source: “나와 다른 대원들 때문이냐? 네 녀석이 이 자리를 피하면 우리가 해를 입을까 봐?”

findings.current:
Instead of answering, Namho’s eyes trembled.

I removed his hands from my clothes, exchanged a brief nod with the two of them, and began walking.
findings.defect: The draft assigns both gripping hands to Namho despite the preceding statement that two people grabbed Taekyung, and it changes an exchanged look into a nod.
findings.rationale: The source leaves the gripping hands collectively associated with the two men and explicitly describes 눈인사, a farewell conveyed through the eyes, not a nod.
findings.replacement:
Instead of answering, Namho’s eyes trembled.

I freed my clothes from their grip, met both of their eyes in farewell, and began walking.
findings.source: 대답 대신 흔들리는 눈동자. 옷자락을 붙잡은 손을 떼어 낸 나는, 두 사람에게 눈인사를 건네고 걸음을 옮겼다.

findings.current: Even if I lost, so what? A famous professional Go player had once left behind the saying, *It’s only Go, after all.* To me, it really would have been nothing more than Go.
findings.defect: The quoted saying drops its deliberate repetition and is incorrectly formatted as a thought rather than a quotation.
findings.rationale: 그래 봤자 바둑, 결국 바둑 deliberately repeats “Go,” and the narrator identifies it as a saying left by someone else.
findings.replacement: Even if I lost, so what? A famous professional Go player had once said, “It’s still just Go—in the end, it’s only Go.” To me, it really would have been nothing more than Go.
findings.source: 어느 유명 프로 기사는 그래 봤자 바둑, 결국 바둑이라는 명언을 남겼지만, 내게는 그래 봤자 바둑일 뿐이니까.

findings.current: “Anything will do. You will be confined in the underground prison.”
findings.defect: “Anything will do” wrongly suggests that Baeksang is accepting one of several options rather than dismissing Taekyung's stated motive.
findings.rationale: 뭐든 상관없다 means that whatever Taekyung's reason may be, Baeksang does not care.
findings.replacement: “It matters not. You will be confined in the underground prison.”
findings.source: “뭐든 상관없다. 넌 이 길로 뇌옥(牢獄)에 갇힐 테니.”

summary: The draft omits one physical System-window beat, changes a singular death warning to plural, alters several subjects and actions, and has localized register, terminology, and Markdown issues.
